product: OPW Swivels gas station pump hose/nozel connectors
title: Gasoline Hose Swivel Connectors Recalled by Dover/OPW
tell: Check the model number, which is clearly marked on the swivel to identify Models 33-C and 34.

title: Flying Toy Helicopter Recalled International Playthings
tell: All units are recalled. The 7 1/2 inch plastic toy is mostly white with three red plastic rotor blades and a green launching handle.

title: Bassinet Repaired by Badger Basket
tell: Only bassinets produced prior to 1982 with the old leg brace design are affected; those produced after 1982 have a different design and are not affected.

product: Jo Gunn Hillbilly Omnidirectional CB Antennas
title: Omnidirectional Cb Antennas Recalled by Jo Gunn Enterprises
tell: The model and company name appear on the shipping carton and instruction sheet, but no labeling appears on the antenna itself.

title: Flying Gym Playground Swings Repaired by Miracle Recreation Equipment Company
tell: All units of Flying Gym models 309, 306, and 305 produced prior to 1985 are included in the repair program.

title: Cordless Telephones Recalled by Mura
tell: Check the label on your cordless telephone handset to determine if it is model MP-510, MP-600, MP-610, MP-650, MP-710, MP-800, or MP-900.

product: Flying Helicopter Toy Recalled by Woolworth
title: Flying Helicopter Toy Recalled by Woolworth
tell: All units of the Summco Flying Helicopter No. 127624 are recalled.

product: Johnson & Johnson Soft Triplets, Piglet Crib Gym, and Triplets marching Band Crib Toys
title: Crib Toys Recalled by Johnson & Johnson
tell: All units of these crib toys are recalled.

product: Creative Playthings expandable wooden enclosures for infants and toddlers
title: Children's Expandable Enclosures Recalled by six manufacturers
tell: All units of these expandable wooden enclosures are recalled.

product: Bilt-Rite Fold 'N GO stroller shoulder harness restraining device
title: Shoulder Harness on Century Strollers Recalled by Bilt-Rite
tell: Check the model number to see if it matches the recalled Century and Bilt-Rite stroller models containing a shoulder harness.

product: Country Cozy's Crazy 'Bout You 12 inch teddy bear
title: 12 Inch Teddy Bear Warning by Country Cozy's
tell: All units are recalled; you can identify the model LSB teddy bear by its dress trimmed with white lace and a ceramic tile stating Crazy 'Bout You.

product: Black & Decker Push Button Command Feed Weed/Grass Trimmers
title: Weed Trimmer Repaired by Black & Decker
tell: Check the model number and label decal tag located near the top of the trimmer between the auxiliary handle and the top handle.

product: Ambi Jack in the Ball Toy Recalled by Five Importers
title: Ambi Jack in the Ball Toy Recalled by Five Importers
tell: All units of this toy are recalled; it is packaged in a carton labeled "Ambi toys Jack in the Ball E153".

title: Nine-Inch Oscillating Desk Fans Recalled by Tatung
tell: Check for the Tatung or Crosley brand names on the decorative base plate, and for one of the listed model numbers printed on the fan bottom.

product: Woodworks Lace Up Horse toy horses
title: Woodworks Lace Up Horses Recalled By Reeves International
tell: All units of this product are recalled. The green wooden horse measures 5.5 inches by 4 inches, has a red shoelace, and came on a blister package labeled "Made in Taiwan."

title: Second Death Moves Sears To Step Up Brawny Bed Recall
tell: All units are recalled; check if your Brawny bunk bed has metal cross wires securely screwed onto the side rails.

title: Folkart Extender #947 Recalled By Plaid Enterprises
tell: All units of Folkart Extender #947 are recalled.

product: TMR Young Rascals American Dream toddler sweatshirts
title: Sweatshirts Recalled by TMR International
tell: All units of the American Dream, Bomber, and Ship toddler sweatshirts in sizes 2, 3, and 4 featuring LED lights and button-size batteries on a removable velcro strip are recalled.

title: Proven Value Antifreeze Recalled By Sharp
tell: All units of one-gallon Proven Value Antifreeze are recalled because they lack required child-resistant closures.

title: Pacifiers Recalled By Dan Brechner & Co.
tell: You can tell by the style number 985-060 or 969-644 printed on the package, and a brown rubber nipple attached to a white, pink, blue, or red plastic shield.

title: Official Chopper 9 Flying Toy Helicopter Warning
tell: All units of the Official Chopper 9 toy helicopter are recalled; it is a six-inch plastic flying toy with the number 9 displayed on the cabin.

product: Sunbeam Coffeemaker Flavor-Lock under-cabinet drip coffeemakers
title: Flavor-Lock Drip Coffeemakers Recalled by Sunbeam
tell: Check the metal plate on the back for model number 15306, service number 15-30AC, and date codes GJA, GJB, and GJC.

product: Hedstrom Li'l Steeler Stroller childrens' strollers
title: Li'l Steeler Strollers Repaired by Hedstrom
tell: Check the model number on the identification label on the frame, or look for the Hedstrom name sewn into the safety strap.

title: Omnidirectional CB Antenna Recalled By Granada Electronics
tell: All units of the Model M400 omnidirectional CB base station antenna are recalled.

title: Foam Bath Blocks Recalled
tell: All units are recalled. The top of the box is labeled '20-piece set Soft Bath Blocks' and Item #5768, and the side is labeled with the distributor or manufacturer.

product: C.K. Enterprises le top children's jogging suits
title: Children's Jogging Suits Recalled by C.K. Enterprises
tell: You can identify the recalled jogging suits by style number 4061 and a neck label tag reading le top RN55104.

title: Edison Humidifiers Recalled by Toastmaster
tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the metal bracket on the rear for Model No. 534041B or 534042 and any date code from DF152 through DF212.

title: Clacker Ball Toys Seized By Marshal
tell: All units of this product are recalled.

title: Barrels, Clowns and Bead Rattles Recalled by F.J. Strauss
tell: Check the style number on the packaging or product: style #29/2 Big Barrel in a white package with a one-piece red barrel on the outside, style #29/5 Magic Clown, or style #29/7 Big Bead Rattle.

title: Baby Crib Exercisers Recalled by Danara
tell: You can identify the recalled units by the model numbers 15011 for Winnie the Pooh and 30940 for the Smurf exerciser.

product: ABC Disposal large slant-sided metal refuse bins
title: Garbage Hauler Repairs Large Bins To Meet Federal Safety Standard
tell: The recall involves seven specific large unstable slant-sided metal refuse bins owned by ABC Disposal in Port Richey, Florida that failed federal stability standards.

title: Bicycle Forks Recalled by Cannondale
tell: Check if the fork is used on Model SR900, SR600, SRSOO bicycles or Model SF900, SF500 framesets purchased prior to 1985.

product: Mongtomery Ward Signature gas surface cooktops
title: Cooktops Repaired by Tappan
tell: Lift the cooktop to find the model number on a label at the left rear corner of the burner box.

title: IC Irrigation Controllers Recalled by Toro
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the plastic cover for Toro IC4, IC4D, IC8, or IC12, and looking at the model and serial number decal on the bottom of the unit.

title: Voluntary Recall of Electric Clothes Steamers Announced
tell: Check the plastic base cap for the embossed model number Cat. No. WA-111 or Cat. No. WA-222; Special Edition models WA-111SE and WA-222SE are not included.

title: Baby Cribs Seized And Destroyed by Marshalls
tell: All units are recalled. These unsafe cribs have no labeling, but consumers can measure the spaces between the vertical slats; if spaces are greater than 2 3/8 inches, it is recalled.

product: Bilt-Rite Juvenile Products dropside mesh-sided cribs and playpens
title: Mesh-Sided Crib & Playpen Warning
tell: All units of dropside mesh-sided cribs and playpens from the listed manufacturers are covered by this warning.

title: Honkers Dolls Recalled by AVIVA Hasbro
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the doll by its deep pink, orange, or purple plush fabric, plastic nose and horns, and a sewn-on label with model H-15.

product: Trailblazer All Terrain Vehicle (ATV) battery wiring harness
title: Toy ATV's Recalled by Pines
tell: You can identify the affected model by a decal on the rear of the toy designating the name Trailblazer and model number PP9083 produced between July 21, 1983, and April 16, 1984.

product: Crib Brackets & MattressSupport Hangers Replaced by Baby Line
title: Crib Brackets & MattressSupport Hangers Replaced by Baby Line
tell: All units are recalled. The cribs can be identified by the name Questor on a stick-on label underneath the mattress on the headboard or footboard, and by slotted hangers and a tubular mattress support.

title: Infant "Crib Cuddle" Recalled by Century & Product Source
tell: All units are recalled. Infacare units have a small white tag sewn onto the hammock with the Infacare name on it.

product: Folding Sassy Seats portable high chairs
title: High-Chairs Repaired by Sassy
tell: You can identify affected chairs as Folding Sassy Seats with model numbers 021 and 023, featuring round aluminum tubing and bright yellow plastic components manufactured between July and December 1984.

title: Sears Craftsman 22-Inch Hedge Trimmers Recalled by Singer
tell: Check the data plate near the handle for model number 315.796640 and date codes B4322, B4329, or B4336 without a white 100 label affixed below the data plate.

title: Revco De-Icer Recalled by Hysan
tell: Affected cans have a blue and white painted metal label and batch codes stamped in blue on the bottom, while cans with paper labels are not affected.

title: Squeak Pacifiers Recalled by Glenco
tell: Check the model number on the package; model #3180 is recalled while the redesigned #3180B is not.

title: Ladies Active Sweatshirts Recalled by Bernard Chaus
tell: Check for styles 45F70, 54507, and 65402, and a neck label tag reading CHAUS RN 51323.

title: Kerosene Heaters Retrofited by Perfection
tell: Check the identification label on the heater for model numbers 770 or 770-l.

title: Flying Wheels Playground Swings Repaired by Miracle
tell: All units of the Flying Wheels tire swings are included in this recall program.

title: Clickclack Baby Rattle Recalled by Brio Scanditoy
tell: All units are recalled; you can identify the recalled wooden Clickclack rattle by model number 30051.

product: Ambassador 4-cup glass carafes from 4-cup Mini-Drip Coffee/Tea Makers
title: Glass Carafes Recalled by Hamilton Beach
tell: Recalled carafes were sold with 4-cup Mini-Drip Coffee and Tea Makers manufactured between August 1980 and August 1981. Identify by the label on the bottom of the coffeemaker.

title: Electric Space Heaters Recalled by Patton
tell: Consumers can identify the recalled units by looking at the bottom label for Patton Model HF-10 or Sears Model 201-7208 and the words Made in Hong-Kong.

title: Scroller Saws Recalled by Singer
tell: The recall includes only saws with model numbers 315.26750 and 315.26710 that were repaired with a replacement circuit board between October 1980 and June 1984. The model number is on the saw motor plate.

product: Estate Trimmer K & S Brushcutter/Monofilament Trimmers
title: Brushcutters/Trimmers Recalled by K & S
tell: Find the model number on a decal in the middle of the shaft, and the brand name on the engine frame above the starter pull handle.

title: Sweatshirts Recalled by Alexanders
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled sweatshirts by the neck label tag reading Michael Richards.

title: Certain Pacifiers Recalled by Monterey Laboratories
tell: The recall is limited to Pur Model INF-920 regular shaped baby pacifiers sold prior to December 11, 1984, which feature three ventilation holes and the word Pur on the underside.

product: Rainbow Connection, X2 Tiger Parkcycles boys' sidewalk bicycles
title: Parkcycle Front Forks Replaced By Columbia
tell: You can tell by checking if it is a boys X2 Tiger model 2122 or girls Rainbow Connection model 2121 purchased prior to February 8, 1984.

title: Racquets Replaced/Refunded by DP
tell: The aluminum frame racquets involved were sold prior to December 31, 1980.

product: Peoples Drug Stores Recalls Certain Nine Inch Oscillating Fans
title: Peoples Drug Stores Recalls Certain Nine Inch Oscillating Fans
tell: All APL and Snow fans are recalled, while King fans can be identified by model number CYHD-103 and the manufacturer name on the bottom label.

title: Nine Inch Oscillating "Snow" Fan Recalled
tell: Check the metal plate on the bottom for Model CYHD-103 and check that the brand name Snow is at the center of the fan blade guard.

title: Dart Drug Stores Inc. Recalls Nine Inch Oscillating "Snow" Fan
tell: Check for the Snow brand name in the center of the front metal grill, a vertical 2-speed switch at the base, and Model CYHD-103 on the bottom plate.

product: Fimco Big Butch electric pressure washers
title: Safety Tips For Fimco Electric Pressure Washers
tell: All Big Butch electric pressure washers purchased before January 1984 are affected.

title: Binky-Griptight Pacifiers Warning
tell: All units of the Binky Squeaky Pacifier Model 593 are recalled. They feature a pink or blue rigid plastic shield with three vent holes, 'MADE IN JAPAN' embossed, and a rubber nipple/handle with a silver-colored metal sq…

title: Crib Toy Safety Alert issued by Fisher-Price
tell: All units are covered by this alert. The toy is model number 155 Play Gym.
